aspect: Your time is free to them
description: An organisation that shortens its queue pays for staff. An organisation that lengthens it pays nothing, because the cost lands on the person waiting.
energy_note: A cost with no invoice, borne entirely by you.

aspect: The queue has moved into your pocket
description: Waiting is now done at home, on hold, refreshing a portal, chasing a ticket - which looks like less queueing and is more.
Eleven minutes on hold, then a dropped call, then eleven minutes again, then the department closes at four.
